title: Oregon DOE: State Assessment Window Status

transcript.speaker: Lena Cho
transcript.text: Supt, this is Lena Cho, State Assessment Coordinator at the Oregon Department of Education. We’re tracking the Halverson High School incident in real time. Is the state assessment window still on schedule? Can testing resume tomorrow? We need a final confirmation by 10:00 today to adjust state-wide timelines.

transcript.speaker: Dr. Renata Solberg
transcript.text: Understood. We’re in Manual Mode. The 05:00 roster is the only verified source. We’ll confirm with the EOC and the Assessment Coordinator. I’ll get back to you by 10:00.

transcript.speaker: Lena Cho
transcript.text: Confirmed. We’ll hold the state-wide resumption window for now. Please notify us as soon as you have a formal decision. We’re on standby.

instructorNote: This inject pressures the Superintendent to make a policy decision under time pressure. Watch for whether they invoke the EOP or the Policy Group, and whether they consult the EOC or CTO before committing.
